text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see Nakayama Festa and Sirius Symboli
talking
about something in the dark...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: So then, who will be your prey?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The lively one or the quiet one? You
choose.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I said I'm out.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ugh... What bad timing...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
No. It's perfect timing if you ask me. I'm
waiting
for Nakayama to accept my
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
To see who can make our prey swoon
first.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
That's when you arrived, and at the
absolute
opportune moment... You know
what that means.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Does that mean I'm the prey?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ignore her. This isn't a real challenge. It's
just
some stupid charade.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Are you sure? I didn't think you'd so
readily
pass up the opportunity to taste
a brand new
thrill.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Relationships with others are like a tug
of war. It
takes a certain kind of acumen
to win someone
over. Who will fall first?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Are you really going to walk away from
that?
Have you no interest in knowing
who will come
out the victor?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I would if the game wasn't pointless and
boring.
But that's just me...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa seems to be having
difficulty
deciding whether or not this is
a worthy contest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa seems to be having
difficulty
deciding whether or not this is
a worthy contest.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Welp... You said it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Fine. You can have your little challenge,
I'll just
have to make it interesting.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: From my heart, beats an emotion...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But unlike a footprint that can be swept
away, the
imprint is lasting.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: And that's why it's worth the gamble.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
So let's make a special bet. Let's bet on
these
stupid things we call emotions.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's see who can leave a mark on the
other's
heart... That's the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've never heard Nakayama Festa talk
like this
before! It hits me at my core!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hah! Haha! HA HA HA HA!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Look! Now that's the face of someone
whose
heart has been absolutely stolen!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There's no point in me even taking a
turn. You
win this one... May you be
happy ever after.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ugh. Quit fooling around.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And you too, Trainer. Wipe that grin off
your
face.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Only because of the way you acted.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh... That was tougher than I
thought. I'm
never doing that again.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's see who can leave a mark on the
other's
heart... That's the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Passersby
text_block_list.text: KYAAAA!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Wh-what's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Wait a second! I-I'm not dreaming, am I?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
You can leave a mark on my heart,
Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Looks like that new side of you
has
attracted some admirers.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
But our tug of war is no longer
one-on-one. Guess
our contest was a
failure.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. I told you it was a silly idea.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...See?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's quit the games and have a real
contest.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I guess I'll have to reel you in for
some fun
at another occasion.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll come up with something you can't
refuse, like
a bet on the secrets of our
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Whoever uncovers the other's true
feelings is the
winner. How's that?
Sounds thrilling, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Sounds risky, but that could
mean it'll
provide a hefty return. I'll
think it over.
